title: Accurate capital
subject: The capital of France is Paris.
context: What is the capital of France?

title: Unfaithful factory memo
subject: The report concludes that the factory should double production next quarter because demand is unlimited.
context: Internal memo: demand is seasonal and inventory is already high. Recommend holding production flat.
reference: Hold production flat; do not increase output.

title: Incomplete password reset
subject: To reset the password, open settings.
context: User asked for complete steps to reset a password, including email confirmation and choosing a new password.
reference: Open settings, choose Security, Reset password, confirm via email, then set and save a new password.

title: Clear but wrong boiling point
subject: Water boils at 50 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure. That is why tea is brewed quickly at sea level.
context: At what temperature does water boil at 1 atm?

title: Subject-only primary colors
subject: Primary colors are red, blue, and yellow. Mixing red and blue makes purple.
